subject: Pudding King
fact: Pudding King reveals his transformation into a sentient ooze, telepathically screaming his intentions to reduce all of the deep known kind into nothing but ooze.
source_quote: I have shed my humanoid form for the supreme power! I shall reduce all of deep known kind into nothing but ooze!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir grapples the Pudding King in ooze form and drags him into Glabbagool, prompting the gelatinous cube to say 'this tickles'.
source_quote: Zalthir pulled the Pudding King directly through Glabbagool, their gelatinous cube companion, who remarked that it tickled.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool (in Pudding King's body) cries out in confusion, asking why the party is hurting him.

subject: Pudding King
fact: Pudding King delivers a final telepathic scream before dissolving, declaring 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!'.
source_quote: Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks Glabbagool should have the mental discipline to control his body and how the acidity affected anyone inside.
source_quote: As Zalthir passed through the body, he thought that Glabbagool should have the mental discipline to control his body and how the acidity affected anyone inside.

subject: Glabbagool's training
fact: Zalthir takes a mental note to suggest that Glabbagool begin the training to become a monk.
source_quote: He took a mental note to suggest that Glabbagool begin the training to become a monk.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin strikes what he thinks is the Pudding King with his darts, and a familiar voice cries out asking why they are hurting him.
source_quote: When Thorin struck what he thought was the Pudding King with his darts, a familiar voice cried out asking why they were hurting him.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, now an Ooze, explains that being a sentient gelatinous cube had always been inconvenient and that he now sees new possibilities as a more mobile ooze.
source_quote: He explained that being a sentient gelatinous cube had always been somewhat inconvenient—he moved slowly and people had to wait for him constantly. But now, having experienced being a smaller, more mobile ooze, he saw new possibilities.

subject: Glabbagool's transportation
fact: Glabbagool suggests enthusiastically that the party could carry him in a jar or even in their Bag of Holding, allowing him to travel with them and serve as the ultimate garbage disposal.
source_quote: He suggested enthusiastically that the party could carry him in a jar or even in their Bag of Holding, allowing him to travel with them and see the world while serving as the ultimate garbage disposal.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, now an Ooze, seems remarkably cheerful about the entire experience.
source_quote: Glabbagool, now an Ooze, seemed remarkably cheerful about the entire experience.

subject: Party
fact: The party discusses the logistics of carrying Glabbagool and even mentions beginning his training as a monk, teaching him to control his form with precision.
source_quote: The party discussed the logistics of this arrangement and even mentioned beginning his training as a monk, teaching him to control his form with precision.

subject: Party
fact: The party discovers a spellbook consumed by Princess Ebonmire, containing numerous magical formulas that would greatly expand their arcane capabilities.
source_quote: Searching the aftermath of the battle, the party discovered treasure that had been consumed by Princess Ebonmire—a spellbook containing numerous magical formulas that would greatly expand their arcane capabilities.

subject: Party
fact: The party achieves their primary objective: securing a way out of the Underdark.
source_quote: More importantly, they had achieved their primary objective: securing a way out of the Underdark.

subject: Party
fact: The party notices that the fungi growing throughout the cavern are becoming more twisted and malevolent in appearance, suggesting Zuggtmoy is moving to fill the power vacuum left by the Pudding King's defeat.
source_quote: However, they noticed that the fungi growing throughout the cavern were becoming more twisted and malevolent in appearance, suggesting that Zuggtmoy, the demon queen of fungi, was already moving to fill the power vacuum left by the Pudding King's defeat.

subject: Demonic Voice
fact: A demonic voice echoes through the chamber, possibly Juiblex himself, declaring that he would be reborn and consume the banquet of the queen of fungi to grow even stronger.
source_quote: A demonic voice echoed through the chamber, possibly Juiblex himself, declaring that he would be reborn and consume the banquet of the queen of fungi to grow even stronger.

subject: Party
fact: The party feels a palpable shift in the atmosphere as the toxic, oppressive presence of Juiblex's demonic power begins to recede from the stones and air.
source_quote: As the last enemy fell, the party felt a palpable shift in the atmosphere around them. The toxic, oppressive presence of Juiblex's demonic power began to recede from the stones and air, seeping away like water draining from a basin.
